title: Flexibility Extended to Home Buyers Affected by Earlier-than-expected BTO Completion
what_it_is: Flexibility Extended to Home Buyers Affected by Earlier-than-expected BTO Completion

sections.label: BTO completion and key collection
sections.summary: In 2025 about 30% of BTO blocks completed early, with HDB notifying buyers at three junctures and requiring key collection within a month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In 2025, about 30% of Build-To-Order (BTO) blocks were completed earlier than their estimated completion dates at the point of flat booking.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: On average, these blocks were completed about two months earlier.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To assist the buyers with their planning and housing arrangements, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) notifies them at three junctures: one year before, six months before and three months before the expected completion of their flat.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: When their flats are ready, buyers are required to collect their keys and pay the balance flat price within a month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB may provide key collection deferrals to buyers who need additional time to sell their existing flat or work out their financing arrangements.

sections.label: HDB help for financial difficulty
sections.summary: HDB will step in to facilitate arrangements for buyers in financial difficulty who cannot match back-to-back arrangements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, this is to give them adequate time to plan for what they should do with their previous flat, their existing flat, as the Member mentioned.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But in situations where they are already in financial difficulty and are not able to match the back-to-back arrangements, HDB will step in to see how they can facilitate the arrangements so that both the buyers and the sellers, in this instance, can find an acceptable arrangement that works for the both of them.
